planned_observer_bounds.limitation: Counts assume the declared successful event schedule. Unexpected extra signs must fault the bounded observer rather than be silently dropped or treated as a pass.

evidence_limits: Successful native transport records retain exact decoded response/request text and native frame digests; they do not retain complete successful wire-frame bytes. Failed exchanges retain observed partial/full frames and available diagnostics.
Observer facts are signs delivered to on-agent on the tested marks/routes. Zero observer facts does not prove that a peer runtime received or persisted no invalid input bytes.
